entities.summary: George William Foster is an American businessman, physicist, and politician serving as the U.S. representative for Illinois's 11th congressional district since 2013. He was the U.S. representative for Illinois's 14th congressional district from 2008 to 2011. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Bill Foster was a performers & entertainers from Madison (b. 1955-10-07, Madison). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
